tools.name: requestNewTest
tools.description: Submits a request to test a page that has no report yet. Identify its site with siteID if the site is in the listSites output (check the listPages output for that site first), or otherwise name the site with siteName; give exactly one of them. Set reviewImmediately to true for immediate review with immediate approval or rejection and immediate enqueueing if approved (testing then typically takes 2 to 4 minutes); set it to false to queue the request for review by management, which typically takes 1 hour to 1 day. The pageName becomes the name of the page in later listPages output and must differ from the names of the other pages of the site; a siteName becomes the name of a new site and must not match the name of a tested site (ignoring case, white space, and punctuation). The reason is what the reviewer evaluates. A request for immediate review of a page that may already have been tested is referred to management review, and the disposition lists the possible duplicates and similar sites. A refusal, such as a duplicate request or a full queue, is reported in the disposition. Returns a confirmation with disposition details, including, on immediate approval, a report identifier and a question about whether to wait for completion with the awaitTest tool.
